suggestions.quote: Card, 8:05: this year the two economists' model found one fix and only one: a tax on the machine itself. Their fix. Your dial. Not yet checked by other economists (c06, c01).
suggestions.fix: Card, 8:05: this year the two economists' model found that standard fixes like basic income fail, but a tax on the machine itself can stop the race. Their fix. Your dial. Not yet checked by other economists (c06, c01).

suggestions.quote: Card, 8:55: in 2025 Visa said AI agents had already made real purchases for shoppers (c28).
suggestions.fix: Card, 8:55: in 2025 Visa said AI agents had already completed real test purchases in pilot trials (c28).

suggestions.quote: Card, 6:25: a string quartet takes four musicians and the same time it took two hundred years ago, and their pay keeps rising, so live music gets dearer against everything a machine makes (c13); a 2015 study found people prefer handmade things and feel they contain love (c21).

keep.quote: Card, 3:50: in 1930 Keynes named technological unemployment, jobs lost because we save labour faster than we find new uses for it; he called it a temporary phase, and guessed that in about a hundred years, about now, we might be down to a fifteen-hour week (c07, c08).

At the gate an old worker tells the story: a union leader, Walter Reuther, liked to tell how a car-plant manager showed him a hall of machines and asked how he'd collect union dues from them, and he asked how the manager would get the machines to buy cars (c18; card: "a story, retold since the 1950s").

Card, 4:45: this year two economists, Hemenway Falk and Tsoukalas, wrote the sum down: each firm keeps the whole saving and bears only a fraction of the spending it destroys, the rest falls on its rivals; one model, not yet checked by other economists (c01, c02).
